prompt.behavior: Fabric and construction: light-to-medium 175gsm 100% combed cotton single jersey (30/1 yarn), pre-shrunk and anti-torsion, with a soft, relaxed, lived-in hand. The garment is stone-washed after sewing, so the fade is irregular and every piece looks slightly different: a soft, cloudy, mottled wash across the body; noticeably lighter, abraded color along every seam line, the folded edge of the ribbed collar, the shoulder seams, the sleeve hems and the bottom hem, where the stitching shows a pale faded halo; the flat center of the chest and back keeps a deeper tone. Tiny vintage puckering along the chain-stitched seams and double-needle hems. Dry, chalky, fully matte cotton surface with zero sheen. 2x1 ribbed crew neck, ring-knit with no front seam, about 2 cm tall, lying flat; shoulder-to-shoulder internal tape keeps the shoulder line clean; side seams hang straight with no twist. Movement: supple and light — the regular body skims the chest without clinging and forms small, soft, rounded folds at the waist and inner elbow; where a hand pulls, the fabric creases easily like a tee that has been washed many times.
prompt.fit: Fit on the model (size M on a 1.84 m, 84 kg man): body length 72 cm ending at the hip, chest width 54 cm giving 2–4 cm of relaxed ease, shoulder width 46 cm with the shoulder seam sitting exactly on the shoulder point, sleeve length 18 cm ending mid-bicep.
